::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 17th 1876  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 12-13
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Thanks for the [estimate](organizations/other_160.qmd) of the copyrights, which is a good deal what I expected, as I thought they must be more valuable to me than to anyone else.

I cannot think what [Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd) is about. A month ago he wrote to me in a great hurry for more copy of the [Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_124.qmd) saying you wanted the third volume finished, I sent him up at once all but the last two or three chapters which are now ready, and nothing more have I heard of them - no proofs nor any sign of  his going on.

I do not think it was quite settled what I was to have for [My Young Alcides](cmy_books/cmybook_112.qmd).  I should be glad to know.

Yours truly
C M Yonge
